newsitem.title: USA: BFGoodrich sells two Kentucky facilities.
newsitem.headline: BFGoodrich sells two Kentucky facilities.

text.p: BFGoodrich Co said Wednesday it has a definitive agreement to sell its chlor-alkali and olefins facilities in Calvert City, Ky., to The Westlake Group.
The sale is expected to be completed during the third quarter, subject to certain regulatory filings and normal closing matters, the company said.
The chlor-alkali and olefins operations produce ethylene, propylene, chlorine and caustic soda, and have about 200 employees.

"The sale of this non-strategic commodity chemical business will allow us to continue to accelerate the expansion and growth of our specialty chemicals and aerospace businesses." BFGoodrich Chairman and Chief Executive David Burner said in a statement.
The Westlake Group, which is based in Houston, is a manufacturer and supplier of petrochemicals and plastics.
